thesis: The episode introduces Dominic Garcia, the chief investment officer for the Public Employees Retirement Association of New Mexico, a $16 billion pension system serving over 90,000 members. The conversation covers his career path, including his early work in the New Mexico legislature, his brief tenure as CIO at age 28, and his recruitment to the State of Wisconsin Investment Board before returning to New Mexico in 2017. The discussion also addresses the transition from a restrictive legal list of investments to the Prudent Investor Act, which allowed the inclusion of alternative assets.
